description: This file defines FastAPI endpoints for health checks and status monitoring within the litellm proxy server, including health endpoints, service checks, shared status, and model connection testing.

methods.name: _resolve_os_environ_variables
methods.description: Resolves environment variable references in a nested dict/list structure, replacing 'os.environ/VARIABLE' strings with actual secret values.

methods.name: _convert_health_check_to_dict
methods.description: Converts a health check database record to a dictionary format for API responses.

methods.name: _check_prisma_client
methods.description: Checks if the Prisma database client is initialized; raises HTTP 500 if not.

methods.name: _save_health_check_to_db
methods.description: Saves health check results to the database, handling errors gracefully.

methods.name: _build_model_param_to_info_mapping
methods.description: Builds a mapping from model parameters to model info objects for health check aggregation.

methods.name: _aggregate_health_check_results
methods.description: Aggregates health check results per model, counting healthy/unhealthy endpoints and capturing errors.

methods.name: _save_health_check_results_if_changed
methods.description: Saves health check results only if status changed or after a certain interval to reduce database writes.

methods.name: _save_background_health_checks_to_db
methods.description: Performs background saving of health check results for multiple models, with optimization to reduce writes.

methods.name: _perform_health_check_and_save
methods.description: Performs health check on models and optionally saves results to database.

methods.name: callback_name
methods.description: Returns the name of a callback function or string.
